email.body1:
Christina, saw Teamworks closed its $235M Series F at a $1.3B valuation and folded in Telemetry Sports, Opteamal, and PFF's enterprise business.

That much M&A usually scatters data across systems, and the gap becomes speed: in-market accounts surface faster than ops can route. Our AI SDR turns signals into personalized outreach autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep, auto-logged to your CRM.

I built a personalized signal play for Teamworks off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Christina, quick follow-up for Teamworks.

After three acquisitions, revops usually inherits messy handoffs where data hygiene and slow routing quietly cost meetings, and the warmest accounts slip through before anyone acts. Tighter sequencing and our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70%.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I would change, scoped to how Teamworks generates pipeline. Measurable lift, not a rebuild.
email.body3:
Christina, last bit of proof for Teamworks.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Teamworks' reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
